{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A refined wool-blend blazer in charcoal gray (#2F373C), tailored fit with a single vent at the back.
High-waisted trousers in black crepe (#000000), straight-leg cut reaching just above the ankle.
A silk blouse in cream (#FFFDD0) with a relaxed collar and subtle pleats down the front.
Round-toe pumps in black leather (#1C1C1C), heel height of 7 cm.
Statement silver hoop earrings.
Why this outfit works: This ensemble perfectly balances her request for "strictly classical" style with the energetic atmosphere of a rock concert by keeping the silhouette clean and structured while allowing her to stand comfortably in a crowd. The dark, neutral palette of charcoal and black ensures she looks polished without blending into the background under club lighting, while the cream blouse adds a necessary touch of warmth and contrast against the autumn evening setting. Choosing tailored separates over a full suit offers the versatility needed for an evening event where she can move freely from standing in a line to dancing on the floor."}
